title: lastrea ascendens
intro: Lastrea ascendens, commonly known as Asplenium ascendens, is a species of fern in the family Aspleniaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea ascendens include antimicrobial and antifungal activities, as well as its ability to modulate the immune system. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
